proof_body:
by
  intro R L M _ _ _ _ _ _ _
  letI : LieRing (Module.End R M) := LieRing.ofAssociativeRing
  letI : LieAlgebra R (Module.End R M) := LieAlgebra.ofAssociativeAlgebra
  refine ⟨UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.lift R (LieModule.toEnd R L M), fun x m => ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.lift_ι_apply]
    rfl
  · intro g hg
    apply (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.lift_unique R (LieModule.toEnd R L M) g).mp
    ext x m
    exact hg x m
target_source: ∀ (R : Type*) (L : Type*) (M : Type*) [CommRing R] [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra R L] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [LieRingModule L M] [LieModule R L M], ∃! ρ : UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra R L →ₐ[R] Module.End R M, ∀ (x : L) (m : M), ρ (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.ι R x) m = ⁅x, m⁆
